title: EcoNest
description: Open-source aquarium diary application for documenting aquatic life. Focused on metadata management, image handling, and status tracking with a rich, interactive interface.

title: ssh-alert
description: Rust security tool that monitors SSH login attempts and sends real-time alerts, keeping self-hosted servers under control and raising awareness of unauthorized access.

title: StringProgressBar
description: Tiny Python library that renders progress bars as plain strings — works anywhere, including Discord bots. Published on PyPI as StringProgressBar.

title: CloudFlare-Dynamic-DNS
description: Python DDNS updater that keeps Cloudflare DNS records in sync with the current public IP address. Supports multiple zones and records within each zone.

title: WeeHTTP
description: Minimalist HTTP web server written in C. Lightweight and easy to use, designed for hosting simple websites or applications that don't need heavy infrastructure.

title: content-provider
description: Python content system (fern-content-system) that serves content across the fern.fun ecosystem, providing a shared content layer for multiple apps.
